rows.text: The statement titled 内閣総辞職にあたっての内閣総理大臣談話, dated 30 August 2011 and filed under 菅総理の演説・記者会見等, says that the Kan cabinet resigned en masse that day (菅内閣は、本日、総辞職いたしました) and reviews its work since the cabinet's launch in June of the previous year.
